# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Prism Drop Royale` as a browser-native, portrait-first top-down survival shooter. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: joystick movement, hold-to-fire with heat/overheat, auto-targeted player shots, AI escort allies, enemy waves, cover collision and line-of-sight blocking, kill scoring, HP failure, and restart. Transform the presentation into this prompt: Battle Royale. A satirical game inspired by Pink Floyd built around battle royale play, with competitive, futuristic, addictive energy, with friends session design, search-friendly hooks like battle royale, shooter, multiplayer, aesthetics like anime aesthetic, chrome aesthetic, cyberpunk, and meme-tone cues such as goated, era. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player is a Prism Drop commander in a satirical Mirror Dome battle royale. Rival echoes spawn around the arena, chrome shards provide cover, the friend squad follows and fires, and the HUD uses competitive meme-era shooter language. Use CSS and Canvas procedural art: neon prism cones, chrome/anime silhouettes, cyber grid, magenta/cyan/yellow highlights, compact mobile HUD, large tappable controls, and fast onboarding.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: Top-down survival shooter / last-stand arcade defense.
- objective: Move a central commander with a virtual joystick, hold fire to shoot auto-targeted enemies, protect the player and escort allies, and survive escalating waves while raising the kill score.
- input model: One-thumb/dual-thumb mobile controls: virtual joystick for movement, hold/touch fire button for continuous shooting, click/tap start and restart CTAs.
- core loop: Start -> spawn player plus 10 allies -> enemies spawn around the camera -> player/allies fire bullets -> bullets collide with enemies or cover -> score increments on kills -> enemy bullets damage player/allies -> continue until player HP reaches zero.
- fail/friction state: Player HP depletion triggers game over; heat accumulation temporarily blocks firing; cover blocks movement and line-of-sight shots; allies can go down and revive.

## Protected Mechanics
- Virtual joystick movement, friction smoothing, world bounds, camera follow, and cover collision resolution.
- Hold-to-fire, auto-target direction, bullet speed/lifetime, heat/overheat cooldown, enemy and ally bullet collision semantics.
- Enemy wave spawning, enemy pursuit/shooting, ally follow/attack/down/revive behavior, score values, HP/failure/restart behavior.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/start/game-over copy, palette, canvas drawing colors/forms, background texture/motifs, entity silhouettes, feedback GIF presentation, font styling, audio labels, and mobile UI chrome are safe because they do not alter collision, timing, scoring, inputs, or state flow.
